questions.prompt: What is the main difference between driving pi over RPC and holding it as an SDK session?
options: The SDK session needs a separate process for each expert
With the SDK you call prompt in your own program and it resolves when the run is done
RPC cannot run more than one prompt
The SDK session cannot use extensions
questions.explanation: An SDK session lives inside your program. The call to prompt finishes when the run is done, so you need no process and no agent_settled event.

questions.prompt: Why does makeExpert give each expert its own SessionManager folder?
options: So the three experts share one history
So each expert's session files stay apart, for example agents/sql/sessions
Because the model requires a different folder per prompt
To turn off the system prompt
questions.explanation: SessionManager.create(cwd, sessionDir) keeps an expert's sessions in its own folder, so SQL sessions never mix with the others.

questions.prompt: Your SDK expert needs codemode, and three experts run in one process. What should you know?
options: Codemode loads by itself and has no limit
You must add createCodemodeExtension(), and the experts share a limit of 2 workers
Each expert gets 2 workers of its own
questions.explanation: SDK sessions load codemode only if you add it. Experts in one process share the limit of 2 workers unless you set PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS.
